steps.name: Validate static site inputs
steps.script:
from pathlib import Path
import json

root = Path('.')
required = [root / 'index.html']
missing = [str(path) for path in required if not path.is_file()]
if missing:
    raise SystemExit(f'missing required site files: {missing}')
if (root / '_config.yml').is_file():
    (root / '_config.yml').read_text(encoding='utf-8')
output = root / 'ipad-output'
output.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
(output / 'static-site-report.json').write_text(json.dumps({
    'repository': 'findwoods/findwoods.github.io',
    'indexBytes': (root / 'index.html').stat().st_size,
    'configPresent': (root / '_config.yml').is_file()
}, sort_keys=True) + '\n', encoding='utf-8')
print('static site inputs ok')
